title: Bhoopathi Ranga
desc: Bhaskar, who runs away from home as a child, begins a new life in the city as Bhoopathi Ranga. Years later, he returns home but finds his mother dead and sister banished from the village.

title: Sowbhagya Lakshmi
desc: Chandru learns a shocking truth that Sowbhagya is not his biological mother, forcing his father to recall his past in order to shed light on the same.

title: Love Madi Nodu
desc: Dr Anand marries Sandhya, who is in love with an aspiring music director, Manjunath. Anand promises to unite the lovers but asks Sandhya to stay with him for a week.

title: Captain
desc: V. P. Sathyan, a professional Indian footballer, goes through various ups and devastating downs in his career as he strives hard to fulfil his ambitions.

title: Dosti
desc: When four college friends come to know that one of their classmates did not commit suicide but instead was killed by an MLA's men, they plan an act of revenge against him.
